fair_value_reason: Value per current share at 2027-10-09, after six $0.33 dividends (ex-dates Jul 2026-Oct 2027), SBC counted once. Shares 3,548.6M (3,539.2M A + 9.4M B, 10-Q cover), buyback paused. EBITDA: pro forma 2026E $31.81B = $16,890M + ($37,384M - $19,815M - $1,697M) x 0.94; 2027E x0.965 = $30.70B; 2028E x0.975 = $29.93B; horizon NTM $30.12B. FCF: H2 2026E = (H2 2025 FCF $9,314M - $1,330M net H2 2025 tax receipt [= H1 taxes paid $2,085M - FY $755M]) x pre-tax H1 ratio (8,505 + 559) / (9,921 + 2,085) = 0.755, less ~$0.6B taxes = $5.43B; 2026E $13.93B; 2027E $13.2B; 2028E $12.85B (estimates). (1) EV/EBITDA, weight 0.4: 4.9x x $30.12B = $147.6B; net debt $82.72B - cash FCF $15.33B (5.43 + 0.75 x 13.2) + dividends $7.03B (6 x 0.33 x 3.5486B) + interval SBC $1.75B (H2 2026 $0.65B + 0.75 x $1.45B) + separation costs $1.25B = $77.42B; ($147.6B - $77.42B) / 3.5486B = $19.78. (2) P/E, weight 0.3: 2027E EPS = MarketBeat $3.61 x 0.935 - $0.05 SBC add-back = $3.325; 2028E x0.98 = $3.259; NTM $3.275 x 6.2x (today's multiple on my 2027E) = $20.31, / 1.0239 interval-SBC dilution ($1.75B / $20.66 = 84.7M shares) = $19.83. (3) FCF yield, weight 0.3: NTM FCF 0.25 x 13.2 + 0.75 x 12.85 - SBC $1.45B = $11.49B at today's 16.0% after-SBC yield on 2027E ((13.2 - 1.45) / $73.31B) = $71.8B / 3.5486B / 1.0239 = $19.73. Blend = $19.78 (estimate). Sensitivities: 5.0x instead of 4.9x adds $0.34; H2 2026E FCF at a2's $7.2B adds ~$0.35; 5 dividends instead of 6 adds $0.13 (blended).
supervisor_summary: All five round-2 forecasts now value the package (close plus distributed NBCU/Sky value), with fair values of $20.3-21.7. They share one material error: horizon deleveraging rests on 2025 FCF that the company itself says included a $2.0B one-off cash tax benefit, while taxes paid fell to $559M from $2,085M in H1. Normalized 2026E FCF is ~$13.9B, not $16.5B. Adding a5's two correct catches (a sixth pre-horizon dividend and the SBC paid in shares before the horizon), fair value per current share is ~$19.8, about 4% below spot, so the 6.4% dividend is essentially the whole expected return. Thesis break is $15.5 (~4.4x horizon NTM EBITDA); the Q3 print on Oct 22 is the first test of the normalized cash-flow view.
key_drivers: Free cash flow is lower than the run-rate the agents used: FY2025's $19.2B included a $2.0B one-off cash tax benefit, and H1 2026's $8.5B benefited from taxes paid falling to $559M from $2,085M. My normalized 2026E FCF is ~$13.9B and 2027E ~$13.2B, so net debt falls only to ~$77.4B by the horizon with buybacks paused and six $0.33 dividends.

Connectivity is shrinking: Q2 2026 C&P adj. EBITDA -5.7%, broadband -167K. The CFO says fiber overlap grows 4-5% a year and Q3 losses will not improve y/y; KeyBanc forecasts 558K/665K losses for 2026/2027. Pro forma EBITDA 2026E is ~$31.8B, falling ~3% a year.

The stock is priced for decline (~5.0x NTM pro forma EBITDA, ~6.2x 2027E EPS, ~16% after-SBC FCF yield on corrected 2027E). With multiples flat, value per current share is ~$19.8 at the horizon, so the 6.4% dividend is essentially the whole expected return.

The NBCU/Sky spin (10-Q: mid-2027, up to 19.9% retained) is value-neutral on this target apart from ~$1.25B of costs and dis-synergies; the Form 10 debt split and the pending Moody's/S&P actions are the main pre-horizon swing factors.

Post-horizon risks priced in the 4.9x multiple: SpaceX's 800 MHz purchase (needs FCC approval; experts see a coverage layer, not yet a head-on rival), NBA rights at ~$2.5B/yr (H1 2026 licensed programming $8.65B vs $5.28B, Media EBITDA $282M vs $790M), and cable credit stress.

method.supervisor: replaces mean only on high confidence
method.platt_applied_to: P(close >= research-day spot), as a location shift frozen per research round

target_definition.definition: VALUE PER CURRENT CMCSA SHARE at the 2027-10-09 close = CMCSA close on 2027-10-09 + (number of NBCUniversal/Sky SpinCo shares distributed per CMCSA share before 2027-10-09 x SpinCo close on 2027-10-09) + any cash or other property distributed per CMCSA share in the separation before that date. Regular quarterly dividends ($0.33) are excluded. If the spin has not completed by 2027-10-09 this is simply the CMCSA close.
target_definition.why: Listed CMCSA options are adjusted for a spin-off distribution, so the market leg is effectively value per current share. All five round-2 forecasters adopted this definition.
target_definition.spin_facts_verified: 10-Q Q2 2026 (re-opened 2026-10-12): 'The NBCUniversal Spin-off is expected to be completed in mid-2027'; Comcast expects to retain up to 19.9% for up to one year after completion, to be monetized tax-efficiently; no assurance a separation will occur. 8-K Ex. 99.1 2026-06-29 (opened in round 1): tax-free spin in approximately one year. Q2 2026 release: share repurchases paused on 2026-06-29.
target_definition.retained_stake_treatment: The up-to-19.9% retained NBCU stake stays inside CMCSA and is already in the CMCSA close; only the distributed ~80.1% is added back.
